facts.note: Transcript states that when the temple struck ten, the kitchen clock showed a quarter past ten, and that she keeps it fast on purpose.
Lina came down at twenty-three minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed until after the temple struck eleven.
Piano began at twelve minutes to eleven and stopped at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed three minutes past eleven.

added.quote: In my kitchen, from the evening until the end.
added.why: Rosa places herself in the kitchen for the whole evening from dinner onward, so she has no whereabouts of her own to check between dinner and eleven apart from the kitchen.
